name: @liminalkeys/sign-action
description: GitHub Action: Liminal Keys cloud CI setup, enroll, sign-check, teardown

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:post
scripts.build:main: ncc build src/main.js -o dist/main-build --minify --source-map --license licenses.txt && mv dist/main-build/index.js dist/main.js && rm -rf dist/main-build
scripts.build:post: ncc build src/post.js -o dist/post-build --minify --source-map --license licenses.txt && mv dist/post-build/index.js dist/post.js && rm -rf dist/post-build
